_comment: Hand-curated links between overnight trails in the top-100 catalogue (catalog_data/trails_canada.json) and backcountry campgrounds/permits (backcountry_sites). Backcountry sites have no coordinates, so links can't be derived automatically. Trails are keyed by (name, province_code), the same natural key the trail seed uses; sites by Parks Canada resourceId, with the provider name and code alongside so the seed can warn if they drift (like backcountry_park_overrides.json). `notes` are shown to hikers; `review` holds evidence and open questions for reviewers and is never seeded. `order` is the position along the route in the direction given in `direction`; stops sharing an order are individually booked pads at the same place (`stop`). Every overnight trail in the top 100 appears here; trails with no Parks Canada sites list only `booking`. A few day hikes are listed with `overnight_option: true`: they stay day hikes but their campgrounds are shown as 'Also doable as an overnight'.
status: Approved 2026-10-15. Links marked likely stay likely until verified; the trail page shows them with a 'route order approximate' note. Booking systems marked confirmed: false are shown as 'Booked outside Trekly'. Non-Parks Canada URLs stay null until verified.

confidence.exact: Parks Canada's own data ties the site to this route: its map area (Jasper 'Skyline'), its trail-code prefix (Banff 'Sk' = Skoki), or a description that names the route.
confidence.likely: Inferred from route knowledge and site names; Parks Canada's data doesn't say so. Check before approving.
